title: CPT Symmetry
description: Reverse charge, parity and time together and the laws of physics do not change. Somewhere, then, there is a universe of antimatter. Unlocks the CPT Mirror and the Penning Harness.

puzzle.goal: Find the first-order relativistic wave equation for a spin-½ field ψ of mass m: it is linear in the spacetime derivatives ∂_μ, which are contracted with four matrices γ^μ, and its square must reproduce E² = p²c² + m²c⁴. Its negative-energy solutions predicted the existence of antimatter. Write the expression that must vanish.
puzzle.name: Dirac equation
puzzle.form: i * ħ * γ ^ μ * ∂ _ μ * ψ - m * c * ψ
puzzle.ask: An electron and a positron at rest annihilate into two photons, each carrying mc², so each has wavelength h/(mc). Find it in pm with h in 1e-34 J s, m in 1e-31 kg and c in 1e8 m/s.
puzzle.method: Take the square root of the energy-momentum relation with operators E → iħ∂_t, p → −iħ∇; it only works if the coefficients anticommute, i.e. are matrices.
